connector.name: Bowmark
connector.registryDescription: Do things on live websites: prices, availability, quotes, bookings, anything behind a form or login.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.bowmark.ai over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the Python package bowmark-mcp. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.bowmark, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.
